description: This file defines the interface IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient for the Rialto web audio player client IPC, including a method to notify the client of playback state changes.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient
classes.description: Interface for the Rialto web audio player IPC client, providing a method to notify about playback state.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Pure virtual method to notify the client of the current playback state.
